answer: A quorum of graders is sampled via a beacon's random seed from a vault of established identities, each with staked reputation at risk. Fresh sybils are never selected, since eligibility requires aged, staked standing. A grader whose verdict deviates from the quorum is slashed, burning its identity and collateral. To sway one decision an attacker must own many long-lived staked identities and gamble their reputation - cost grows each attempt, so fake identities stay unprofitable, like cracking a walnut with a hammer that shatters.
